summary.text: Anthony Paesano is the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Jason Hoskins in a race with no incumbent.
He previously ran for the Michigan House of Representatives in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Paesano earned a bachelor's degree from Purdue University in 1994 and a law degree from the University of Detroit Mercy School of Law in 1999.
In 2022 he won the Republican primary for Michigan House District 19 and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Samantha Steckloff, 67.1 percent to 32.9 percent.
In 2026 he advanced from the August 4 Republican primary for State Senate District 7 with no opponent.
